title: Set up two-photon variables
description: Adds the data variables the ophys methods read and write, for an entity type, in a data location: .npy arrays and a .json ROI file in a subfolder of each entity's folder. With rawFilePattern, TwoPhotonSeries_Original reads the raw recording through that file pattern. Variables that exist are left alone. Also adds the ophys.imaging and ophys.image_stats columns to the entity type.

rawFilePattern.title: Raw file pattern
rawFilePattern.description: Name of the DSM file pattern that finds the recording. Leave empty to not add TwoPhotonSeries_Original.

addColumns.title: Add the imaging and image statistics columns
